body.name: \Gamma_n^{\mathrm{kc}}(\delta_n)
body.construction: When \(c_P\) is supplied, set \(\mathcal G_c=\{c_P\}\) and define \[\Gamma_n^{\mathrm{kc}}(\delta_n)=3\sum_{k=1}^{K_n}\log\{N_k(c_P)+1\}+\log\frac{|\mathcal G_\vartheta|}{\delta_n}.\] This is \(\Gamma_n(\delta_n)\) from \(\text{def:four-cell-calibration}\) after substituting \(|\mathcal G_c|=1\).
